sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by 
M6 in above title block.

This pump is used to 
transfer condensate water from condenser hot well to dearators to feed pump of 
HRSG.
Pump Technical Specification:

The first draft initiated 
by Eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by 
EDEPC quality control engineer Abouda El-bana, accepted by general director eng. 
Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha 
Power Station.

احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

عزل الدائرة 
 قواطع محرك المضخة.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

يجب عزل المضخة 
 ميكانيكيا عن طريق إغلاق صمامات التسليم والشفط.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

sections.text:
Pump 
out of Operation

Check alignment and 
 compare it with the setting value and record it.

Make test for bearings 
 oil and added or change it ( if it is needed ).

Check flanges for water 
 leakage.

التحقق من تثبيت البراغي، 
 ثم إعادة التصحيح (إذا لزم الأمر).

فحص الغدد للمياه 
 التسرب وإعادة التعبئة (إذا لزم الأمر).

Check the pump casing 
 against rust and re-paint ( if it is needed ).

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by

This pump is used to 
transfer condensate water from condenser hot well to dearators to feed pump of

رقم الموديل | 10 12 كيه كيه
يكتب | Multi Stage - Vertical type
Rated Capacity | 180 m3/hr
ضغط تفريغ المضخة | 12 kg/cm2
Fluid pumped | Condensate water
Design operating fluid 
 temp | 36.1 C
Speed | 1500 rpm
Bearing Type | Upper 7226 thrust & 
 Lower 6215 ball
